candidates.title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Introduces a compact spatiotemporal latent-diffusion formulation for volumetric deformable simulation and shows diffusion avoids non-physical regression averages in chaotic regimes.

candidates.title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Replaces costly joint multi-view generation with distributed local world-model clients coordinated through compact shared state.

candidates.title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Makes local inter-object fit an explicit generation condition rather than generating scene objects independently.

candidates.title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Combines persistent 3D localization, object histories, and contextual descriptions while retaining untouched and out-of-view objects.

candidates.title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Targets success bias in robot video data through counterfactual action post-training and explicit human-rated interaction defects.

candidates.title: PLaW-VLA: Predictive Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Models task-relevant predictive latents instead of reconstructing pixels, cutting world-model inference cost while preserving policy gains.

candidates.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Moves WAM representation from view-dependent pixels to a shared metric 3D motion interface.

candidates.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Establishes empirical scaling laws for multi-embodiment latent robot world models and validates imagination error as a real-robot proxy.

candidates.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Shows long context benefits depend on autoregressive video foundations and packages that history into a real-time WAM system.

candidates.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Adds large-scale metric 3D supervision to a pretrained robot video world model without replacing its visual VAE.

candidates.title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Combines real-home correspondence, interaction readiness, and dense lived-in arrangements in one digital-twin benchmark.

candidates.title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Separates plausible single views from persistent multi-client world consistency with capability-level diagnostics.

candidates.title: OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Provides aligned sim-real tactile tasks and controlled comparisons of tactile representations, fusion, and co-training.

candidates.title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Makes inference latency itself part of the embodied safety environment instead of freezing the world at observation time.

candidates.title: The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Separates embodiment generalization from arbitrary representation-gauge robustness.

candidates.title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-12 arXiv primary-source sweep plus fixed-source checks
candidates.why_candidate: Places coding-agent policies and learned humanoid controllers in the same open, replayable evaluation harness.

candidates.title: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
candidates.why_candidate: Promising 8.90x-10.67x latency result, but the linked project is still an anonymous staging surface and the current run could not confidently inspect representative unedited hardware demos.

candidates.title: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Strong local 3D control, but current evidence is object generation rather than interactive scene/world generation; project relevance is below the branch threshold.

candidates.title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
candidates.why_candidate: Impressive simulation-scale RL, but it is a policy optimization contribution rather than VLA/world-action modeling or shared evaluation infrastructure for this repository.
